items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-09-01
items.q: Yeah. Played at the booths with him a lot of times.

ctx.x: Back to those brass bands here. Well, the Silverleaf brass band, they wouldn't really be playing too much music then, huh? No. Well. They'd be faking a lot of it, huh? Yeah.

Silverleaf had some good musicians. Tuxedo had some good musicians. Now, you take, well, we'd call them the Zulu band. They had a hot brass band, see? Black Benny, myself, Lewis, and what does Tramon play our name? Eddie Morris. Not Eddie Morris. Morris. Morris. Morris French. Morris French played Tramon with Rene. Yeah. And all them kind of fellas. Well, they wasn't reading, but part of the day, they come down the street and tear the street up. Who's this Black Benny you're talking about? Well, he been dead a…

items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1958-05-24
items.q: And he said you'd run Rene, Chris Kelly, and all of them.

ctx.x: I was talking to Sheik about you.
And he was telling me about it in Millenburg. And he said you would run everybody. He said you'd run Rene, Chris Kelly, and all of them.

Yeah, he'd run every Sunday everybody. And then the pavilion. And they were right close together, see. And I was so strong, you know, I was so loud. And the people over on the other pavilion, he was dancing by my music.

items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: None of me, Buddy B. or Randy, or Chris Kelly, none of us played with them kind of bands. We always got our band up together.

ctx.x: But he wasn't a member of the Onward or the Excelsior or any of the old Tuxedo.

I'll tell you how most of this was like, if somebody would hire Buddy, well, he'd pick up his men, the men he wanted to play. But old Tuxedo and other bands like that, he never would play with them. None of me, Buddy B. or Randy, or Chris Kelly, none of us played with them kind of bands. We always got our band up together. But them fellas had their band had their number of men just wanted to buy it.
How many times did y'all work and say, a guy like Rene, a buddy, or you, would you work how many times a week in the street?
